source.notes: GET /sap/bc/adt/debugger/breakpoints answers 200 with a genuinely zero-byte body, captured while the debuggee was suspended with multiple external breakpoints armed (statement, message, exception, plus the line breakpoint from bp-add-while-stopped). This is load-bearing: ADT offers no server-side listing of the armed external breakpoint set — any "list breakpoints" feature has to track its own client-side record of what it armed, it cannot ask the server to enumerate them. The same empty-body behaviour recurs at capture 925 (GET after cleanup, not itself turned into a cassette here), so this is not an artifact of the specific suspended state. Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
